create_targetinfo_namedtuple: create a TargetInfo namedtuple with target, compiler_arch, triple, llc_flags, ld_emu, sb_emu, and cross_headers fields
build_x8632_target: build an X8632Target using TargetInfo with i686-none-linux triple and pentium4m cpu
build_arm32_target: build an ARM32Target using TargetInfo with cortex-a9 cpu and neon attribute flags
run_convert_triple_to_nacl: run ConvertTripleToNaCl to convert a non-SFI Linux triple to a NaCl triple
find_arm_cross_include: find the ARM cross-include path by globbing /usr/arm-linux-gnueabihf/include/c++/*/arm-linux-gnueabihf
